title: German Rhubarb Pie
description: A classic German dessert made with fresh rhubarb and a crumbly crust.
instructions: Make the crust by combining flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Add cold butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into a pie dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, vanilla extract, and confectioners' sugar.
Add the egg mixture to the pie crust and spread evenly.
Arrange the rhubarb on top of the egg mixture.
Bake for 40-50 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the rhubarb is tender.
Let the pie cool before serving. Garnish with confectioners' sugar and jubilant (optional).
